artifact_output_policy: Final user deliverables must be DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or PDF when those formats are requested. Markdown is an internal working format only.

contact_registry.selection_rule: Kepala Sekolah with usable contact first; if unavailable use first usable management contact within same NPSN/source order. When WhatsApp verification is available, NOT_REGISTERED may trigger fallback within the same NPSN.
contact_registry.whatsapp_account_verification: UNKNOWN unless verified by an approved external adapter
contact_registry.target_completeness_invariant: Every source target must appear exactly once in the operational output/report, including no-contact and failed-verification targets.
